gene_sets.membership_policy: exact original GMT membership; no bulk-outcome optimization

rank_score.method: transparent unidirectional singscore-equivalent mean fractional within-sample rank
rank_score.direction_handling: score always measures expression abundance; frozen DOWN programs expect negative disease beta
rank_score.standardization: z-score across all included PE and control samples together within cohort and hypothesis
rank_score.technical_reason_not_package_singscore: the frozen calculation is dependency-light and algebraically follows the single-direction rank principle; within-cohort z-standardization makes affine singscore normalization immaterial

cohort_models.method: ordinary least squares on standardized score

meta_analysis.loco_BH_family: 19 frozen hypotheses valid in each omission

constituent_classification.BULK_ROBUST_SUPPORT: k>=4; BH_FDR<0.05; expected meta direction; expected-direction cohort proportion>=0.75; I2<=60; every valid LOCO has expected direction
constituent_classification.BULK_HETEROGENEOUS_SUPPORT: k>=4; BH_FDR<0.05; expected meta direction; expected-direction cohort proportion>=0.75; I2>60
constituent_classification.BULK_DIRECTIONAL_SUPPORT: k>=4; expected meta direction; expected-direction cohort proportion>=0.75; neither robust nor heterogeneous classification

module_classification.BULK_MODULE_DIRECTIONAL: robust threshold not reached and exact BULK_DIRECTIONAL_SUPPORT count reaches ceiling(0.60*n)
module_classification.BULK_MODULE_DISCORDANT: support thresholds not reached and >=40% of estimable constituents have meta direction opposite the frozen direction

representative_set_rule: lexicographically first gene_set within each module; selected without bulk outcomes

gate_rule.GO_TO_PHASE3: >=3 BULK_MODULE_SUPPORTED and no unresolved critical receiver-method risk
gate_rule.GO_TO_PHASE3_WITH_RESTRICTIONS: >=2 modules are BULK_MODULE_SUPPORTED or BULK_MODULE_DIRECTIONAL but external/covariate/heterogeneity limitations remain
gate_rule.REVISE_RECEIVER_SET: exactly 1 module is supported or directional
gate_rule.NO_GO_RECEIVER_ARM: zero modules are supported or directional
